description: Unit test class for ImmutableJsonWebToken, verifying immutability, equality, parsing, and expiration logic of JWT tokens.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonWebTokenTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests for ImmutableJsonWebToken, including immutability, equality, invalid parsing handling, valid parsing, and expiration checks.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableJsonWebToken instances are immutable and that relevant fields and referenced objects are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that equals and hashCode methods behave correctly for ImmutableJsonWebToken.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromEmptyTokenString
methods.description: Tests that creating a token from an empty string throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToParseTokenFromMissingAuthorization
methods.description: Tests that parsing a token from a missing Authorization header throws JwtInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToParseTokenFromInvalidAuthorization
methods.description: Tests that parsing a token from an invalid Authorization header throws JwtInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToParseTokenWithMissingSignature
methods.description: Tests that a token missing the signature part throws JwtInvalidException.

methods.name: parseToken
methods.description: Parses a valid JWT token string into an ImmutableJsonWebToken object and verifies the header, payload, and signature.

methods.name: checkTokenExpiration
methods.description: Checks whether the token is properly recognized as expired based on the current time.

methods.name: base64
methods.description: Helper method to Base64-encode a string.
